Generate one single realistic landscape image, horizontal aspect ratio 2.3:1. Subject: bare limestone hill country in a Mediterranean semi-arid landscape, viewed obliquely from a drone at moderate altitude. Clear broad rounded ridges, two distinct hilltops with a saddle, a deep winding valley, and sloping rocky flanks; the silhouette and natural landforms must be immediately readable when reduced to a tiny thumbnail. Real terrain texture and believable geology, natural warm sand and muted earth tones, soft warm daylight with shadows defining the hills, atmospheric distant ridges. Terrain fills almost all the frame, only a narrow pale hazy sky strip if any. High quality realistic geographical visualization / landscape photography, restrained contrast matching an elegant cream and olive educational website. No vegetation, trees, buildings, roads, utilities, people, flags, vehicles, text, labels, icons, diagram lines, collage, map, contour lines, cutaway slabs, isolated miniature models, papercraft, cartoon or toy appearance.
